history.summary: A 2016 freehold 1BR in D15 near the new Marine Parade TEL station (630m), but priced at $1,858 PSF — a ~6% premium over the $1,754 median — for a $1.36M quantum that is high for a one-bedder. Weak 2.2%/yr resale appreciation on just 6 txns and a losing arena record (139-174) undercut it.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,858 PSF is ~6% above the $1,754 district median with no offsetting data strength — only 6 txns and a poor 2.24%/yr resale rate. Elo 1082 / 139-174-2 is the weakest record in the batch. $1.36M for a 1BR is a steep quantum that thins the buyer pool. The Marine Parade TEL station is the only redeeming factor and it's already priced in.
red_flags: Priced ~6% above district median PSF with no data support
$1.36M quantum very high for a 1BR — narrow exit pool
catalysts: Freehold in D15 East Coast lifestyle belt
